note.zh:text: 每列各自按最小值→最大值着色（列内归一化，不是全局），所以颜色深浅只表示「在这一列里排第几」；渗透率 / 效率增益 / 市场规模与上方的气泡矩阵同源。
note.en:text: Each column is normalised on its own min–max scale, so darker only means higher within that column; penetration, gain and market size share the same source as the bubble matrix above.
